🚨‼️ Sergio Conceição is among the coaches monitored by Juventus should the club part ways with Luciano Spalletti. ⚪️⚫️The former AC Milan manager knows Italian football well and could also reunite with his son Francisco in Turin.[Rudy Galetti]
Tomorrow, Saturday, October 31st, Luciano #Spalletti will speak in a press conference at 5:00 PM on the eve of #Juve #Napoli 🎙️ @junews24com[Marco Baridon]

📊 October 30, 2026 marks the first anniversary of Luciano #Spalletti on the #Juventus bench.He arrived on October 30, 2025, replacing Igor #Tudor.▪️ His league average is 1.79 points per game, the exact same as #ThiagoMotta and slightly higher than #Tudor's 1.76.▫️ The eliminations from the Coppa Italia and the Champions League left a tally of 21 goals conceded in eighth matches.▪️ The 2025-2026 season ended in sixth place, without Champions League qualification.▫️ The loss of potential income due to the absence was estimated at around €60M.▪️ In April, the club renewed his contract until 2028.[Corriere di Torino via @TUTTOJUVE_COM - @PuebloJ]

🆙🧐 #Carnevali has reiterated the trust in #Spalletti, clarifying that, for now, he is not under discussion and that the blame falls primarily on the players. He scolded the entire squad, inviting them to take responsibility and to stop looking for alibis or shifting the blame onto the coach: for the club it is not a tactical issue and the primary person to blame is not him, but the players, there is a lack of grit, character, pride and sacrifice. The message: "Remember that you are #Juventus". An immediate reaction, with facts, has been demanded.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

ℹ️‼️ #Spalletti has called the entire squad to la Continassa for the training retreat until the #Napoli match, including the injured players: the only absentee will be #Grabara, who is still in Poland. The choice stems from the need to regroup the team, rediscovering team spirit, a sense of belonging and determination. The goal is to present themselves with a completely different attitude: the response, however, must come from the pitch.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

😶‍🌫️ #Spalletti has started the training retreat until the match against #Napoli to regain character and intensity, with the possibility of extending it based on the responses. The club has also requested an immediate change of attitude. Within the group, different assessments of the physical condition are emerging: some believe that the close commitments have penalized the training sessions, while others point the finger at the poor application of a part of the squad. The less intense training sessions, also designed to manage the many absences, have come under observation. The players have also undergone weight checks: the test was passed by everyone, without anomalies.[TuttoSport via @juv

🆙❗️"The training retreat is a choice shared by everyone at #Juventus. #Spalletti did not have this decision forced upon him, but personally supported the option: he believes there is a need to rediscover spirit, focus and hunger. The club is reacting and wants to send a signal as early as Sunday, in terms of both result and performance. The trust remains total and strong, but now it will be necessary to change course, otherwise everyone is risking heavily - players and coach."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙🤨 At #Juventus, perplexity is filtering out on the work done at la Continassa: during training sessions, there is a lot of talking and analyzing of tactics for long periods, while little work is done on the pitch. The starters often end up running on empty after one half and the second-string players appear tired and out of breath.[La Stampa via @Juventus_Reborn]
